player_prompt.intro:
Inwe uwe Player {player_id} e Connect Four.
Kipimo chako cha disc ni: {symbol}.
Bodi ya mchezo ina safu {num_rows} na safu wima {num_cols}.
Wachezaji wanabadilishana kudondosha disc zao kwenye mojawapo ya safu wima (0 hadi {end_col}).
Mshindi wa kwanza ni yule anayepatana na (zake mwenyewe) diski nne wima, mlalo, au diagonally.
Unapofika zamu yako, ingiza nambari ya safu wima kwenye mabano ya mraba ili kufanya zamu yako.
Kwa mfano: '[col 4]' au '[col 1]'

board.board_visible_state: Piny ma ne nitie e Od Bura: {board_visual}
board.board_notvisible_state: Jothum ok nyal neno board mar tugo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Fomu ya chanzo si sahihi. Umbo lililotarajiwa: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Chanzo si halali. Kolom {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Chanzo si halali. Kolom {col} imeshikwa.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} odhiyo disk yake ({player_symbol}) kwenye safu wima {col}.

outcome.draw: Tugo ne orumo ka onge ng'ama oloyo.
